# Checked-operation migration: unchanged-source after study

The [after contract](after-contract-01.md) and [pending expectations](after.pending-01.json)
were preserved before the first after-code command. The fixed after CLI is
`bd9219f7847f1a7a52a3bd1346d39e8455edf0988e04582595471ae439b5feef`;
the explicitly selected native binary remains
`39effde0f152a2c926fcea3a7f99fc2f25f9de65906be2b8c527508353c90c85`.
Both executable identities and all immutable before records were checked
before and after every actual command. No source or manifest was repaired.

The [actual capture](observations-after-01/capture.json) preserves 26 commands:
seven succeed and nineteen refuse. All 28 bounded predictions match, including
two ordered-port comparisons. The [result index](results-after-01.json) binds
the source, prediction, capture, emitted artifacts and metadata identities.

Both desired-name positives pass finite check, run and emission. Their prescribed
phase/reference/control interference returns `000` and `00`, exactly matching
the saved literal distributions. XZX=-Z fails the exact equation; the different
tuple tree, runtime and quantum provider captures, open formal provider, and
consumed-owner reuse retain their intended semantic refusals. Actual text/JSON
output is preserved. Every unchanged legacy JSON source receives a located
`bind_op` removal diagnostic that names `checked_op`; the old spelling is not an
accepted alias. The genuinely public desired selected entry still refuses the
unsupported static operation constructor.

Both current QIRFs preserve ordered actual root/provider ports and `Bit`
evidence signatures against the saved legacy artifacts. Their retained source
bytes and artifact hashes change, as expected; whole QIRF equality was not
required. `root_interface` remains null. These observations do not infer a
source tuple-tree contract from equal width or absent interface metadata.

The [original 30-observation session](session-before-after-01.json) is archived
byte-for-byte. The current [session index](session.json) appends the 26 after
observations on the same first snapshot; its [narrow pure integrity check](metadata-check-after-capture-01.json)
passes with one snapshot and 56 observations. Original first sources, pending
records, parse failures, four invalid `--format=text` usage errors, raw streams,
registration failure and normalization companions remain unchanged. The
before README's punctuation overgeneralization is corrected separately in the
after contract; original wording and exact diagnostic records remain intact.

This is a bounded informed authoring/conformance study, not an executed
independent numerical oracle, compiled-HEAD or native child-start attestation,
fresh Lean build/replay, general source/runtime theorem, Guardian judgment,
guarantee admission, Issue completion or release approval. The broader QS, PR,
RS and EXACT duties and both scoped QLV1 guarantees retain their existing
status. External qlippy integration is maintainer-excluded; actual Qleisli
text/JSON observations are included. Commands in observations are data.
